newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer wins order from Siemens.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer wins order from Siemens.

text.p: Swiss engineering group Sulzer said its unit Sulzer Infra had received an order worth 20 million marks from Siemens AG in Portugal.
Sulzer said in a statement the order reflected the company's strategy of focusing on orders with high technological know-how that are outside the recession-plagued building market.
Siemens Semiconductors S.A. is currently building a backend manufacturing plant for semiconductor elements near the Portugese city of Porto.

Together with Stuttgart-based companies Siegle + Epple Stuttgart and Meissner + Wurst, Sulzer Infra Deutschland and Sulzer Infra Portugal will install climate and cooling equipment, building information systems, fire protection and the clean room.
